# Retired words, one per row: <word><TAB><what replaced it>.
# TestRetiredWordsAppearOnlyInRecords fails when a tracked .go, .md, .yml or .sh
# file uses one outside the dated records (CHANGELOG.md, RESOLUTIONS.md,
# docs/RELEASE-NOTES-*, docs/ratings/, anything under a testdata/ directory) and
# outside the naming files that state the replacement (docs/TERMINOLOGY.md,
# docs/GLOSSARY.md, docs/sprint/GLOSSARY.md and the lint's own test). Matching is whole-word, any case.
asleep	down
untiered	no tier
git bus	nova-bus

# The ledger: <LEDGER><TAB><path><TAB><word> is a file that still uses a retired
# word and awaits its own card. It only shrinks: a new row is a refusal, and a
# row whose file no longer uses the word fails until the row is deleted.
# asleep is still the daemon's state word in the code; a card per group of
# files removes it, and each such file is a row here until then.
